statements.chinese: 真是的！那家伙怎么回事啊？

statements.english: You'd forgive me if I fogged you
statements.chinese: 若我令您困惑，还望海涵。

statements.english: You did , a little bit
statements.chinese: 你确实有一点。

statements.english: Oh , my God , honey . I'm so sorry
statements.chinese: 天啊，亲爱的，我真的很抱歉。

statements.english: - I totally forgive you . - Really ?
statements.chinese: - 我完全原谅你了。- 真的吗？

statements.english: So listen . You know my friend Chris who owns the crematorium ?
statements.chinese: 听着，你知道我那个开殡仪馆的朋友Chris吗？

statements.english: Crematorium Chris ? Sure
statements.chinese: 火葬场Chris？当然。

statements.english: He said he would cremate my fur coat for free ..
statements.chinese: 他说他会免费火化我的毛皮大衣...

statements.english: ... if I bring in the next person I know who dies
statements.chinese: ……如果下一个我认识的将死之人被我带来。

who.definition: 谁（关系代词的作用说明）

dies.definition: die（第三人称单数现在时）: 死亡

statements.english: Oh , my God !
statements.chinese: 天啊！

statements.english: Oh , my God . Look at these pelts !
statements.chinese: 天啊，快看看这些毛皮！

statements.english: Don't get too attached . She's having it cremated
statements.chinese: 别太留恋了。她准备把它火化。

statements.english: Uhh , Phoebe , honey , honey , I know you're quirky
statements.chinese: 呃，Phoebe，亲爱的，亲爱的，我知道你有点古怪

statements.english: and I get a big kick out of it , we all do actually
statements.chinese: 我从中获得了极大的乐趣，实际上我们大家都是如此。

statements.english: But if you destroy a coat like this ..
statements.chinese: 但如果你毁掉这样一件外套……

statements.english: ... that is like a crime against nature
statements.chinese: 这简直是对自然的亵渎。

statements.english: Not nature . Fashion !
statements.chinese: 不是自然。是时尚！

statements.english: This is fashion ?
statements.chinese: 这也算时尚？

statements.english: So to you , death is fashion ?
statements.chinese: 所以对你来说，死亡是一种时尚？

statements.english: That's really funny
statements.chinese: 这真有趣。

statements.english: Here's Phoebe ..
statements.chinese: 这是Phoebe...

statements.english: ... sporting cutting-edge hairy carcass ..
statements.chinese: ...配备前沿的毛坯车身...

statements.english: ... from , you know , the steel traps of wintry Russia
statements.chinese: ……来自，你知道的，俄罗斯寒冬般的钢铁陷阱。

statements.english: You really think this looks good ?
statements.chinese: 你真觉得这好看吗？

looks.definition: look（第三人称单数）: 看起来

statements.english: Because I do !
statements.chinese: 因为我乐意！

statements.english: I know , I miss you too . I can't wait to see you
statements.chinese: 我知道，我也想你。我迫不及待想见到你。

statements.english: I love you . Bye
statements.chinese: 我爱你。再见。

statements.english: What is in here , rocks ?
statements.chinese: 这里面是什么，石头吗？

statements.english: No , it's my collection of fossil samples
statements.chinese: 不，这是我的化石样本收藏。

statements.english: So , rocks
statements.chinese: 所以，岩石。

statements.english: I'm really gonna miss this apartment
statements.chinese: 我真的会很想念这间公寓。

statements.english: You know , Ben took his first steps right over there
statements.chinese: 你知道吗，Ben就是在那儿迈出了他的第一步。

statements.english: Remember when I ran into this thing and
statements.chinese: 还记得我撞上这个东西的时候

statements.english: it kinda knocked me out a little ?
statements.chinese: 这让我有点招架不住。

statements.english: I love this place
statements.chinese: 我爱这个地方。

statements.english: To tell the truth , I wish I didn't have to move
statements.chinese: 说实话，我真希望不用搬家。

didn't.definition: do（过去式否定）: 构成过去时否定

statements.english: Are you saying that you're not entirely happy about this ?
statements.chinese: 你的意思是说，你对这件事并不是完全满意？

statements.english: If Emily gave me a choice ..
statements.chinese: 如果Emily让我选择...

statements.english: You do have a choice !
statements.chinese: 你确实有选择！

statements.english: Ross , why are you listening to her ? Are you crazy ?
statements.chinese: Ross，你为什么要听她的？你疯了吗？

statements.english: What ?
statements.chinese: 什么？

statements.english: It's not right what Emily wants you to do . She's totally ..
statements.chinese: Emily想让你做的事不对。她完全...

what.definition: 什么（关系代词的作用说明）

wants.definition: want（第三人称单数）: 想要

statements.english: Stop pinching me !
statements.chinese: 别掐我了！

statements.english: Look , now you guys said I only had to keep my mouth shut
statements.chinese: 听着，现在你们几个说我只要闭嘴就行

had.definition: have（过去式）: 构成过去完成时

statements.english: as long as Ross was happy , right ?
statements.chinese: 只要Ross开心就好，对吧？

statements.english: He just told me that he's not entirely happy
statements.chinese: 他刚刚告诉我，他并不是完全开心。

statements.english: What's going on ?
statements.chinese: 发生什么事了？

statements.english: We all hate Emily !
statements.chinese: 我们都讨厌Emily！

statements.english: No !
statements.chinese: 不！

statements.english: No , Ross , we do not hate Emily
statements.chinese: 不，Ross，我们并不讨厌Emily。
